note: The player-facing HUD and display options with their defaults, as data, for the settings menu and for Rendering (its FlashView reads info_flashes). UiHud loads these defaults over its own. Keys match UiHud.opts. Accessibility options are marked; none of them removes an information channel.

info_flashes.label: Info flashes
info_flashes.help: Short flashes on a fighter's head that tell you what it senses: danger, found, searching. Off hides only these; emotion flashes and the wear crown are separate.

silhouette.label: Body figure
silhouette.help: A small body figure beside each nameplate that shows wear, always on. On in training and by the accessibility default.

crown_always.label: Keep the wear crown up
crown_always.help: The wear crown stays around both fighters instead of popping. Head flashes still show; the crown dims under one.

brink_cue.label: Brink ring
brink_cue.help: A thin faint ring around a fighter on the brink.

captions.label: Captions
captions.help: Bracketed sound tags such as [wince] on spoken lines.

reduced_motion.label: Reduced motion
reduced_motion.help: No flicker, shimmer or shrinking rings, and the split screen swaps sides with a quick fade instead of a swing. Shared by the HUD and the camera (which caps shake at a quarter). Every cue keeps a shape.

split_solo.label: Split screen against the AI
split_solo.help: Use the split screen when you play alone against the AI. Off keeps one camera on your fighter and shows the rival by an edge pointer and the ring map when it is far.

shake_scale.label: Screen shake
shake_scale.help: How much the camera shakes, from 0 (none) to 1 (full). Reduced motion caps it at a quarter.

show_prompts.label: Show prompts
show_prompts.help: Button prompts on the parry ring, the finisher rings and under your nameplate. Always on in training and in the first three matches.

glyph_style.label: Glyph style
glyph_style.help: The look of the button glyphs. Neutral is our own position diamond with letters. A device family's own letters wait for a licence check.

hitstop_scale.label: Hit pause
hitstop_scale.help: How long the game freezes on a heavy hit, from half to full. The freeze is a whole number of ticks in the simulation, so this only sets which table it uses.

hotseat_alt_layout.label: Alternate hot-seat keyboard layout
hotseat_alt_layout.help: A second keyboard layout for two players on one keyboard. Off keeps the default layout.

vfx_quality.label: Effects quality
vfx_quality.help: How much debris, dust and cracking the effects draw. Auto picks by how fast the game is running; the others fix it. Fewer effects never hide a cue.

keep_hints.label: Keep tutorial hints up
keep_hints.help: In the guided first match, a hint stays on screen after you have done what it asks, until the next hint replaces it.

control_hints.label: Control hints
control_hints.help: A small legend of your controls in your corner. Auto shows it at the start of every match and in your first matches, always keeps it up, off hides it.

camera_zoom.label: Camera zoom
camera_zoom.help: How close the camera frames the fight, from 0 (far) to 10 (close). Fighters keep a minimum size on screen either way.

camera_shake.label: Camera shake
camera_shake.help: How hard the camera shakes on hits and blasts, from 0 (none) to 10 (most). Reduced motion caps it at a quarter.

pad_preset.label: Controller layout
pad_preset.help: Arena: triggers dodge and charge power, bumpers guard and switch mode. Brawler: bumper and trigger attacks, face buttons for power and mode. Simple: fewer buttons, the game picks heavy, mode and specials for you.

left_handed.label: Left-handed touch layout
left_handed.help: On a touch screen, the buttons on the left and the move stick on the right.

thickness.label: Crown thickness
thickness.help: Arc thickness of the wear crown: 0.75, 1, 1.5.

region_label.label: Place names
region_label.help: The place under the camera on the planet strip.
